reviewer.version: Codex review session 2026-10-19; model build identifier not recorded
reviewer.method: Cumulative dated source reviews retained with original scope, bounded access/compression/gate delta review, exact-candidate hosted evidence and scanner reconciliation. Tag image aliases and signed provenance/SBOM verified against repository, workflow, source SHA and release ref. Historical repairs retain historical reproduction references.
limitations: Not an independent human assessment, penetration test, compliance audit or certification; not an exhaustive audit.
No live provider/SMTP/OIDC or deployed-production configuration assurance. Scoped mocks and source guards are not fault injection at every endpoint.

287 hosted alerts remain open (9 high, 127 medium, 151 unrated scanner classifications) with bounded documented dispositions; scanner success does not close them. Five additions since the historical record are reconciled in the access source review.
Unperformed manual device/screen-reader/pilot checks remain unverified despite operator acceptance of current state.
Trusted-role arbitrary SQL and host administrators are outside the claimed boundary; TD-RISK-073 remains approved 1.x work.
CSP/COEP explicitly accepted October 19 for 05abb13 only; review before next runtime candidate or November 12, whichever is earlier. Mailpit exception expires October 24, unchanged.

Validation combines local and hosted boundaries, not one uninterrupted local aggregate. The tag run's original Hypothesis timing failure did not reproduce with its exact seed locally; cause remains unknown and the failed attempt is retained.
